name: Escher
biography: Escher is Strahd's vampiric coachman and cupbearer, a creature of wit, hunger, and guilt. He is a vampire spawn and a dangerous but not immortal foe at the crossroads.

items.name: Claws
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Bite
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (1d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
